description: IRDIS is the infrared dual-band imager and spectrograph inside SPHERE. This set adds the common-path neutral-density filters and the neutral-density H23 dual-band to the IRDIS filters also filed under Paranal/SPHERE.
facility_description: SPHERE, the Spectro-Polarimetric High-contrast Exoplanet REsearch instrument, is mounted on the VLT at Paranal.

links.label: ESO Science Archive data access policy

notes: NJM's info.json for SPHERE/IRDIS records no curve URL. The band names match the ESO filter page and, for the ND set, the columns of SPHERE_CPI_ND.dat. ND3.5 is a column name in that file, not a magnitude.
